title: Communications Bench and Equipment Service Bay
description: One static communications maintenance-preparation desk scene from the original communications repair-desk direction. Five whole published props at original unit scale: an open four-leg worktable, its complete desktop transceiver including handmic and coiled lead, a separate empty handheld cradle on the tabletop, an entire empty two-collar mast service stand on the left ground and the whole recessed-port cable reel on the right ground. The radio and cradle have full original feet resting on the actual table surface; the ground equipment remains laterally separated from the table, and a continuous open front approach remains across a single scene-only4.6x2.8x.12m pad. This is not the earlier dish/cabinet/portable-radio communications station or the saw-on-two-sawhorses carpentry corner. No old components are extracted or resized. All original world triangles and per-face opaque PBR remain, original static transforms baked into scene mesh coordinates.60closedmeshes13970tri21PBR. One scene, zero new standalone models. The cradle and mast collars stay empty; no fake handset, cable connection, power circuit or mast insertion is invented. This is a static equipment preparation arrangement, not a demonstrated repair, RF link, charge operation, working electronics, human reach, installation, load or safety certification. Preview ground excluded.
